_comment_purpose: OPT-IN replacement for tmbilling-worker.json: a restart starts the NEW worker first and
only then stops the old one, so the old process can finish long jobs without the billing
Why: a fork app's `pm2 reload` is stop-then-start, so the drain IS a billing gap and has
to stay short (25s). Jobs outrun that — measured on production 2026-09-11..27:
metric_windows_refresh 46 s p50 (every run), metrics_daily_snapshot ~60 s, drift scan
Safe to overlap: graphile serializes a named queue with a row lock, so the new worker
cannot claim a queue the draining one still holds, and its cron is multi-worker safe.
The draining worker keeps heartbeating, so the stranded-lock sweep never mistakes it
_comment_script: Same cluster rules as tmbilling-api-cluster.json: `node_args` MUST be an array (the
string form is silently ignored), and pm2 forks the worker itself, so the tracked pid
is the process doing the draining. WORKER_ROLE is set in env as well as --role, since
`node_args` loads deploy/pm2/tsx-preload.mjs by ABSOLUTE path, not `--import tsx`. A cluster
child starts in the pm2 DAEMON's cwd and gets this file's `env` only later, so a bare
`--import tsx` failed (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, exit 1, crash loop, no app log) and tsx lost
tsconfig's `@/` alias for dynamic imports. First prod switch, 2026-09-27: rolled back.
name: tmbilling-worker
_comment_ready: wait_ready: pm2 stops the old instance only after the new one sends 'ready', which
worker.ts does once the queue is running and the health listener is up.
_comment_kill_timeout: Strictly greater than WORKER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS below (30 min), with headroom for the
post-drain stamping and log flush. A job still running at the budget is cut off and its
lock is recovered by the 5-minute stranded-lock sweep.
_comment_malloc: MALLOC_ARENA_MAX below does NOTHING in cluster mode: glibc reads it at exec, and a cluster
child gets this env only afterwards, copied into process.env from JS (pm2 ProcessContainer).
It must be set on the pm2 daemon, whose env the child inherits: deploy/README.md §7. Kept
here so the fork config and this one stay in step.
_comment_switching: exec_mode cannot be changed by a reload, so the switch is a one-time manual step, in a
quiet window (the delete is a real stop — it drains with the fork budget):
That renumbers the worker's pm2 id once; every later deploy is `pm2 reload` and keeps it.
To go back: pm2 delete tmbilling-worker && pm2 start deploy/pm2/tmbilling-worker.json
